meta.source: UNRA Axle Load Data Jul 2014.accdb (weighbridge ticket records, decoded via mdbtools)
meta.drop_reason: missing/zero legal GVW limit, non-finite dates, or implausible actual GVW (<=3t or >=150t, data-entry errors)
meta.methodology: Actual GVW = sum of measured Axle1..Axle10 loads (tonnes) per ticket. Legal GVW = max_GVW field (vehicle-class-specific legal limit per Uganda axle load control regulations). Overload % = (actual - legal) / legal * 100. A ticket is overloaded when actual GVW exceeds its legal limit.
